comments.author: @AmazingDiscoveriesTopUS
comments.text: Would you give up the comfort of modern life to live completely free in Slab City? 🌵🏜 No rent, no traditional rules, but also limited clean water, healthcare, and security. Is this the ultimate freedom or a price too high to pay? 🤔 Watch until the end and tell us: Could you live here? Why or why not? 👇

comments.author: @MrCuriousEN
comments.text: Slab City is fascinating because it turns freedom into a very practical question. 🌵🏚 Living without rent or conventional services sounds liberating, but water, healthcare, heat and security suddenly become personal responsibilities. The most interesting part is how people still create informal systems, art spaces and community rules even in a place built around rejecting conventional structure.
